notes.title: Hats and Guns demo now available! 🤠
notes.content:
[h2][u]Come and try the Hats and Guns demo[/u] 🌵[/h2][p]Two years after the start of our first game, we are glad to present our first demo.[/p][p]The main game systems are in place, but we are still working on many new features. We plan to update this demo regularly until the game is released.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy this demo![u]

[/u][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260904/b3bc63f5b5f27037b6f526d62f31a0a9030785a3.png"][/img][/p][h2][u]Join us on Discord ![/u] [url="https://discord.gg/NabwwuUc" style="button"]Join the Discord[/url][/h2][p]We’d love to hear your feedback and chat with you. If you enjoyed our demo, feel free to join our Discord. That way, you can follow the development of Hats and Guns more closely. 🤠[/p]

notes.title: What’s New in Hats and Guns
notes.content:
[p]We’re a small team of young French developers, passionate about deckbuilding and big fans of Westerns. From that passion was born [b]Hats and Guns[/b], our very first indie game.
[/p][p]Up until now, we haven’t used Steam much to communicate. But now that the game is well on track, we’ll be sharing regular updates about our progress here. [/p][p]And here comes our [b]BIG ANNOUNCEMENT[/b]:
The public demo of Hats and Guns will be released this September, along with a brand-new trailer!
[/p][p]But before that…
A private demo will be available starting [b]Monday, August 25[/b], exclusively for members of our Discord.
[/p][p]This is the perfect time to join us, request a key, and chat with us. Your feedback is incredibly valuable and will help us a lot.
[/p][p]See you soon—and as Tuco would say: [i]“Every gun makes its own tune.”

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260904/61f6113ed0c9c60f3b5fd046d0b76d184ca54146.gif"][/img][i]

[/i]

 

[/p]
